footnote_text: The common stock is a restricted stock unit which represents a right to receive one share of common stock for each restricted stock unit. || The number of restricted stock units awarded to the Reporting Person is a prorated portion of the Reporting Person's equity grant amount based on the number of days between August 17, 2026 and the Annual Meeting date divided by $127.24, the closing price of CVSA common stock on October 15, 2026. || The restricted stock units will vest in full on November 12, 2026, subject to the Reporting Person's continued service on the Board through the vesting date.
